facts.fact: The World Bank G2Px blog reports that public wage recipients in the Central African Republic expressed high satisfaction with mobile money salary payments, having before 2020 travelled up to two days to collect cash salaries.
The World Bank G2Px blog reports that recipients of Morocco's DAAM program valued receiving payments into an account, enabling ATM withdrawals 24 hours a day with no waiting.

The World Bank G2Px blog reports that recipients of the Jigisèmèjiri emergency social safety net program in Mali received payments into mobile money accounts and appreciated walking to the nearest agent.
The World Bank G2Px blog reports that recipients of the Vision Umurenge program (VUP) in Rwanda highlighted cost savings from mobile money payments with reduced travel.
